References:

  2. Christopher M. Bishop, "Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning." Springer (2006). Download Link -- Main book for most models.
  3. Raschka, Sebastian, Yuxi Hayden Liu, and Vahid Mirjalili.
    Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn: Develop machine learning and deep learning models with Python.

Syllabus (broad indication):

  • Introduction and concept learning, Linear models for classification and regression, SVMs and kernel methods
  • Probabilistic ML, Naive Bayes, Decision Trees, Bagging, Random forests
  • Boosting, Xgboost
  • Clustering, Gaussian Mixture Models
  • Graphical Models
  • Neural Networks
  • Learning Theory and Metrics for problems
  • Active, Transfer, multi-task learning
  • Explainability and Trustworthiness
